description: Abdul Majeed Ummu Thahira v. Commulage Don Mable Jeeny Rose Abdul Majeed Ummu Thahira v. Commulage Don Mable Jeeny Rose View More before Hon. W.L. Ranjith Silva, J.
parties: Abdul Majeed Ummu Thahira v. Commulage Don Mable Jeeny Rose Abdul Majeed Ummu Thahira v. Commulage Don Mable Jeeny Rose View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court judgement upholding the Respondent’s title to the premises in suit, contending that the relevant deed was invalid as it bore only the executant’s left thumb impression without a separate mark in terms of Section 2 of the Prevention of Fraud Ordinance No. 7 of 1840. Held - such non-compliance concerned the form and did not invalidate an otherwise valid deed under Section 33 of the Notaries Ordinance. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Prevention of Fraud Ordinance No. 7 of 1840; Notaries Ordinance of 1901
